staticText.text:
Build your potential | Identifying the text type

When you first read a text, think about these questions.• What is it? (eg an article, an email, an advert)• Where is it from? (eg a news website, a novel, social media)• What is the purpose of the text? (eg to give information, to sell something, to give an opinion, to entertain)• Who is the author? (eg a student, a company, a reporter)This information can help you to understand the general meaning of the text.
